name: A Warrior's Training
summary: Lyria Du Lac sends young warriors from Goldshire to Stormwind for lessons in battlefield endurance. At the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town, veteran Harry Burlguard puts them through seasoned instruction.

sections.title: From Elwynn to Old Town
sections.body: When you have shown your skill against threats across Elwynn Forest, Goldshire's trainers have little more to teach. So Lyria Du Lac sends you to Stormwind and the rough district of Old Town. Veteran fighters gather there to share what combat has taught them, far from the royal garrison's rigid ways.

sections.title: Lessons of the Veteran
sections.body: Harry Burlguard is an aged battle veteran who keeps his quarters at the Pig and Whistle Tavern. He tests your mettle with drink and practical trials of stamina, not parade-ground drills. Before teaching defensive moves for dangerous campaigns, Harry expects you to match his appetite for drink and face the tavern's local brawlers.

faq.answer: Lyria Du Lac, the warrior trainer behind the blacksmith in Goldshire, offers this training after you prove your early combat skill.

faq.q: Where can Harry Burlguard be found?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard can be found inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind City's Old Town district.
Harry teaches practical moves and stances to help warriors endure longer in the field. His lessons begin with tests of stamina.

faq.q: Why is training held in a tavern instead of the barracks?
faq.answer: Old Town is Stormwind's traditional, rough heart, where retired soldiers and hardened veterans gather. Harry teaches over ale and with bare-knuckle discipline, away from the barracks' formal military ways.

faq.q: What comes after speaking to Harry?
faq.answer: After speaking with Harry, you face Bartleby the Drunk, a local brawler. The challenge tests your physical resilience before your training is complete.
Only warriors can receive this training. It belongs to the dedicated warrior training line.

angles.text: As a warrior, this rite marks your passage from local militia recruit to an officially recognized soldier of the Alliance. It opens the way to advanced stances and defensive techniques.
As a human fighter, your path leads from Elwynn's pastoral defenses into Old Town, the ancestral, working-class cradle of Stormwind's martial heritage.
As an Alliance recruit, you can carry practical brawling wisdom from veterans like Harry Burlguard toward contested borders, alongside book-learned tactics.
